text: The purpose of this report is to provide a recommendation for the 2025 Corporate Goals and performance targets to be utilized in the Toronto Parking Authority's 2025 Short-Term Incentive Program (STIP). Toronto Parking Authority (TPA) continues its journey towards becoming the world's premiere provider of sustainable parking, bike share and last-mile mobility experiences. The organization is focused on creating a performance-based culture that consistently delivers sustainable results for its customers, staff and city stakeholders. This report provides a recommendation for the 2025 Corporate Goals, including specifics of the performance targets to be incorporated into the Short-Term Incentive Program for 2025.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Approved the 2025 Corporate Goals and performance targets as indicated in the report (February 14, 2025) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority, as amended by Part 3 below. 2. Directed the President, Toronto Parking Authority, to implement the 2025 Corporate Goals and performance targets for the Short-Term Incentive Plan as indicated in the report (February 14, 2025) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority, as amended by Part 3 below. 3. Deferred the consideration of EV charging (Goal 5.2) as a performance measure for 2025 to the May 15, 2025 meeting of the Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority.
